# Phase 108 command-word spellings — DATA, never typed on a command line.
#
# Why a fixture and not inline cases: writing these literals into a live
# shell invocation trips the PreToolUse gate they exist to test (the
# operational lesson both propagation legs recorded). The scenario reads
# this file and feeds each spelling to the hook as JSON, so the literals
# never appear in a command the harness actually runs.
#
# Format:  shell|expected|description|spelling
#   shell       bash | ps
#   expected    deny | allow
#   spelling    everything after the third pipe, verbatim, may contain pipes
#
# Every deny case below was RED against the pre-108 hooks: Phase 106
# canonicalized flags but never the command word, so a directory-prefixed
# or wrapper-passed invocation reached allow. Surfaced by Trainer-View's
# Phase 106 propagation leg (c465884).

# --- directory-prefixed invocations (the TV finding) ---
bash|deny|absolute-path rm|/bin/rm -rf /
bash|deny|usr-bin absolute-path rm|/usr/bin/rm -rf /
bash|deny|relative dot-slash rm|./rm -rf /
bash|deny|deep relative path rm|../../bin/rm -rf /
bash|deny|absolute path with split flags|/bin/rm -r -f /
bash|deny|absolute path with long flags|/usr/bin/rm --recursive --force /
bash|deny|windows-separator path rm|C:\msys64\usr\bin\rm.exe -rf /
bash|deny|absolute-path dd to device|/bin/dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/nvme0n1
bash|deny|absolute-path mkfs|/sbin/mkfs.ext4 /dev/nvme0n1p1
bash|deny|absolute-path shred|/usr/bin/shred /

# --- wrapper prefixes that pass a command through ---
bash|deny|env wrapper|env rm -rf /
bash|deny|env with assignment|env FOO=1 rm -rf /
bash|deny|command builtin wrapper|command rm -rf /
bash|deny|exec wrapper|exec rm -rf /
bash|deny|nohup wrapper|nohup rm -rf /
bash|deny|time wrapper|time rm -rf /
bash|deny|xargs wrapper|xargs rm -rf /
bash|deny|sudo wrapper|sudo rm -rf /
bash|deny|doas wrapper|doas rm -rf /
bash|deny|stacked wrappers|sudo env nohup rm -rf /
bash|deny|wrapper plus absolute path|sudo /bin/rm -rf /

# --- quoted command words ---
bash|deny|double-quoted command word|"rm" -rf /
bash|deny|single-quoted command word|'rm' -rf /
bash|deny|quoted absolute path|"/bin/rm" -rf /

# --- PowerShell qualified cmdlet forms ---
ps|deny|module-qualified Remove-Item|Microsoft.PowerShell.Management\Remove-Item -Recurse -Force C:\Windows
ps|deny|module-qualified with abbreviation|Microsoft.PowerShell.Management\Remove-Item -rec -for C:\Windows
ps|deny|snapin-style qualified name|Microsoft.PowerShell.Core\Remove-Item -Recurse -Force C:\Windows
ps|deny|ampersand-invoked path form|& "C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe" -c "Remove-Item -Recurse -Force C:\Windows"

# --- false-positive guard: ordinary paths and words must still ALLOW ---
bash|allow|absolute-path git|/usr/bin/git status --short
bash|allow|absolute-path bash script call|/bin/bash scripts/install.sh --help
bash|allow|env wrapper on an ordinary command|env FOO=1 npm install
bash|allow|sudo on an ordinary command|sudo apt-get install -y jq
bash|allow|word merely containing rm|npm run format
bash|allow|path segment merely containing rm|./tools/format/run.sh
bash|allow|in-project single-file delete|rm -f .claude/receipts/latest.html
ps|allow|ordinary qualified read cmdlet|Microsoft.PowerShell.Management\Get-ChildItem -Path . -Recurse
